definitions.full: H7844. shechath [ שְׁחַת ] verb corrupt ( ᵑ7 J (once), Syriac ; Biblical Hebrew [ שָׁחַת ]); — Pe`al Passive participle feminine singular שְׁחִיתָה Dan 2:9 corrupt word; as noun = fault 6:5 (twice in verse) (compare ᵑ7 Psa 17:3 ; Ruth 4:22 ).
